newsitem.title: USA: Famous Dave's names Lanham president, COO.
newsitem.headline: Famous Dave's names Lanham president, COO.

text.p: Famous Dave's of America Inc, a barbecue restaurant developer, said Monday it hired Douglas Lanham as president and chief operating officer and will elect him a director.
William Timm, who has served as president, will assume the position of executive vice president.
Lanham has had some 25 years' experience in the restaurant business. Since 1994, he has been associated with Chili's Grill and Bar restaurants both at Brinker International Inc and as a franchisee.
Famous Dave's also said it employed consultant Stan Herman as executive vice president, strategic planning and marketing.
